summary: A diary entry often ends with the writer going to bed.
realLife: Pepys ended coronation day by going to bed after the evening's drinking.
sources: Diary of Samuel Pepys, April 1661 (coronation day, April 23), Wikisource: https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Diary_of_Samuel_Pepys/1661/April
inGame: The `ahead` move of the first evening ('Tomorrow...'); no record needed beyond the day.

turns.pulledBy: unease about the speech or the day
turns.writesBack: the entry says the writer stayed up and what about
the entry says what the writer missed
